component.name: YugiTokenBar
component.summary: Fill a Yu-Gi-Oh! card collection with AI coding token usage

description.p: YugiTokenBar reads the local usage logs of Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding tools and turns the tokens into coins.
Spend the coins on booster packs to collect the Korean releases of Yu-Gi-Oh! cards.
This is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with Konami.
